name: AI Geode
description: An AI player that learns Geometry Dash levels from its own deaths.

ai-enabled.name: AI Player
ai-enabled.description: Let the AI play levels by itself. While it is on, your own jump inputs are ignored in levels. Toggle at any time with the keybind below.

toggle-ai.name: Toggle AI
toggle-ai.description: Immediately turns the AI player on or off (releases the button at once).

learning-enabled.name: Learning
learning-enabled.description: Update the AI's memory after every attempt. When off, the AI replays what it already knows without changing it.

learning-speed.name: Learning Speed
learning-speed.description: How aggressively values and timings change after a failure. Low = cautious and stable, high = fast but noisier.

auto-retry.name: Auto Retry
auto-retry.description: Automatically restart after a death while the AI is playing.

respawn-delay.name: Respawn Delay
respawn-delay.description: Seconds to wait after a death before the AI retries.

practice-mode.name: Practice Mode Learning
practice-mode.description: Play in practice mode and let the AI place its own checkpoints, so hard sections can be learned separately. It removes a checkpoint again if it keeps dying right after it.

training-speed.name: Training Speed
training-speed.description: Game speed multiplier while the AI is playing (physics stay deterministic at 240 steps per second; music will desync above 1x).

prediction-enabled.name: Use Prediction
prediction-enabled.description: Simulate the player's path before each decision (every game mode): avoid predicted collisions, pick timings by simulation, and learn rejected timings without dying. Each mode is used once its physics have been calibrated from your own play.

show-trajectory.name: Show Trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Draw the predicted path of the action being executed: green = safe, yellow = uncertain, red = collision, grey = not current; purple = what keeping the previous input would do. The label shows the action, its safety and any SAFETY OVERRIDE.

show-orb-trajectories.name: Show Orb Trajectories
show-orb-trajectories.description: For the nearest orb: its area (yellow box), where it would be activated (yellow dot), and the outcome that is not selected: orange = the path if the orb is activated, grey = the path if it is not. The selected path is always the action really executed: it shows the orb's effect only if the AI presses in the orb. The label compares both outcomes.

show-proximity.name: Danger Colours
show-proximity.description: Colour the selected trajectory by how close it comes to deadly geometry, step by step: green = clear (at least the 'safe' clearance), orange = getting close, red = very close (at most the 'danger' clearance) or a collision; yellow = uncertain movement (unmodelled objects). A ringed dot marks the closest point; the label shows its clearance and risk.

proximity-scoring.name: Clearance in Decisions
proximity-scoring.description: Score candidate timings by their clearance to deadly geometry along the whole predicted path (more margin up to the 'safe' clearance is better, closer than 'danger' is penalised). Off: the pre-v0.7.0 score (clearance only counted up to 10 units).

proximity-safe.name: Safe Clearance
proximity-safe.description: Units of clearance (a block is 30) from which a path counts as clear (green).

proximity-danger.name: Danger Clearance
proximity-danger.description: Units of clearance at and below which a path counts as dangerously close (red), a near miss is recorded, and learning gets a small penalty.

show-alternative.name: Show Alternative Path
show-alternative.description: Also draw (in blue) what would happen with the other button state.

strategic-planning.name: Strategic Planning
strategic-planning.description: Plan whole obstacle sequences ahead (cube and robot) from the level geometry: input sequences of up to three presses are simulated over all of them, and the controller gets the plan as a candidate when it is safe at least up to its last landing. The controller still decides and checks every input.

prediction-horizon.name: Prediction Horizon
prediction-horizon.description: How far ahead (seconds) the path is simulated. Longer sees further but costs more and is less certain.

show-understanding.name: Show Level Understanding
show-understanding.description: Draw what the AI believes is in the level. Filled boxes = objects read from the level (red hazards, grey blocks, cyan simulated portals); outlines = what the AI inferred (white obstacle groups, orange tight landings, blue the planned sequence, green landing space); lines and dots = predicted movement (the planned path, presses, landing targets); yellow / magenta / orange outlines = not simulated, moved by triggers, rotated (approximate). A strip at the bottom shows the whole level.

understanding-overview.name: Level Overview Strip
understanding-overview.description: Show the strip with the whole level, its obstacle groups, physics changes and the player.

understanding-objects.name: Extracted Objects
understanding-objects.description: Show the hitboxes read from the level around the player.

understanding-groups.name: Obstacle Groups
understanding-groups.description: Show the obstacle groups found in the level and the sequence being planned.

understanding-landing.name: Landing Zones
understanding-landing.description: Show the free landing space after each group and the planned landing points.

understanding-plan.name: Strategic Plan
understanding-plan.description: Show the strategic plan's predicted path and presses.

understanding-alternatives.name: Alternatives
understanding-alternatives.description: Show where the other evaluated first presses would start.

understanding-uncertain.name: Uncertain Geometry
understanding-uncertain.description: Show (and warn about) objects that are not simulated, are moved by triggers, or whose hitbox is approximated.

show-panel.name: Show Status Panel
show-panel.description: Show the compact AI status panel in levels.

show-debug.name: Show Debug Data
show-debug.description: Add the AI's current observation and decision values to the status panel.
